name: Mass Change Queries
description: You are given an array a consisting of n integers. You have to process q queries to this array; each query is given as four numbers l , r , x and y , denoting that for every i such that l ≤ i ≤ r and a i = x you have to set a i equal to y . Print the array after all queries are processed.
input_specification: The first line contains one integer n ( 1 ≤ n ≤ 200000 ) — the size of array a . The second line contains n integers a 1 , a 2 , ..., a n ( 1 ≤ a i ≤ 100 ) — the elements of array a . The third line contains one integer q ( 1 ≤ q ≤ 200000 ) — the number of queries you have to process. Then q lines follow. i -th line contains four integers l , r , x and y denoting i -th query ( 1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ n , 1 ≤ x , y ≤ 100 ).
output_specification: Print n integers — elements of array a after all changes are made.
approach_summary: Build a Segment Tree over the array. Implement point update and associative range query operations in O(log N) time per query.
